cases.question: the cheapest stocks by P/E (absolute low; check for sub-2 junk)
tool_calls: screen_unified fundamental=[{concept:pe,pattern:low}] sort=pe asset_type=[Common Stock] limit=10
cases.result_summary: 40-row buffer is DOMINATED by implausible sub-2 P/Es: top rows pe 0.006 (Connexa), 0.011 (Seafco), 0.016, 0.017, 0.021... ~30 of 40 are P/E < 2. Legit-cheap names (Country Garden 1.30, Villeroy & Boch 1.08) are buried; real value names (single-digit-but-plausible PE) never surface at all.
cases.evidence_check: FAIL on hygiene. A P/E of 0.006 = the whole company priced at 0.6% of one year's earnings = stale/one-off/erroneous earnings, not a real bargain. The engine does NOT exclude implausible near-zero P/E value-traps; 'low' just returns the raw arithmetic bottom.
cases.confusion_note: Tool+params were OBVIOUS. The defect is in the ENGINE output, not param selection.
cases.reason: Absolute cheap-P/E screen returns nonsensical sub-2 / near-zero P/E junk with no abnormal-value filtering; result is unusable for the user's real intent (cheap real companies).

defects.desc: No implausible-value hygiene on absolute low-P/E screens: sub-2 and near-zero P/E (0.006, 0.01, 0.02...) pass straight through. ~30/40 rows are junk value-traps; genuine cheap names are crowded out. Engine should floor/flag abnormally-low P/E (e.g. exclude PE below ~2-3 or mark as abnormal) the same way abnormality SIGNALS exist elsewhere.

cases.question: stocks trading below 12x earnings (absolute P/E threshold)
cases.result_summary: Threshold=12 applied (P/E ratio, sent as 12 not 0.12 - correct, multiples are not fractions). But sorted-ascending output is the SAME sub-2 junk flood as case 9: pe 0.006, 0.01, 0.015... ~30/40 sub-2.
cases.evidence_check: PARTIAL. The 12x threshold itself is correct and correctly-scaled (multiple, not fraction). But 'below 12' with no lower floor lets every near-zero P/E through, so the practical result is the same value-trap junk. No abnormal-low exclusion.
cases.confusion_note: Tool+params OBVIOUS; correctly did NOT scale 12 to 0.12 (P/E is a multiple). Defect is again engine-side (no lower-bound hygiene).
cases.reason: Threshold param correct and correctly-scaled, but absence of an implausible-low floor means sub-2 junk dominates, same as case 9.

defects.desc: Absolute 'below X' P/E has no implausible-low floor -> the same near-zero P/E value-traps flood the top. A sane cheap-P/E screen should exclude/flag PE below ~2 (or negative/near-zero earnings artifacts).
